name: DJ Amp
author: MatrixJockey
description: An AI agent DJ that runs cliamp for you: it reads the deck, picks the next record before the current one ends, and takes requests in plain English.

barWidget.description: Now playing from cliamp, a live spectrum analyzer, and an AI DJ that mixes the next track and takes requests.

schema.label: Autopilot
schema.description: Let the DJ pick the next record on its own as a track runs out, instead of only answering requests.

schema.label: Standing brief
schema.description: What the DJ should aim for when you haven't asked for anything, e.g. "instrumental while I'm working, louder after 9pm".

schema.label: How far the DJ may reach
schema.description: Playlists keeps it to the playlists you already have. Adding search lets the DJ pull tracks off the network through cliamp's search.

schema.label: Agent
schema.description: Which coding agent CLI does the thinking. "auto" follows `omarchy default agent`; "off" runs the built-in rule-based DJ instead.

schema.label: Cue the next record (seconds before the end)
Announce the DJ's calls
schema.description: Send a desktop notification whenever the DJ changes what's playing.
